Around the County
Stay up to date
Cass County Land Bank Authority Notice of Closeout Public Hearing
Cass County Land Bank Authority will conduct a closeout public hearing on November 13, 2026 at 10 a.m. at the Cass County Administration Building. Read on...
Notice of Intent to Forfeit — October 12, 2026
In accordance with Michigan law, all of the items have been run through the Law Enforcement Information Network to verify ownership, or to check for lost or stolen reports. Read on...
Prohibited invasive red swamp crayfish found in Cass County
Invasive red swamp crayfish have been found in southwest Michigan’s Cass County for the first time, according to the Michigan Department of National Resources. Read on...
Cass County Friend of the Court launches Customer Satisfaction Survey
The Cass County Friend of the Court is inviting all families served by its office to take part in its 2026 Customer Satisfaction Survey. Read on...
Cass County deputies recognized for life-saving measures
Deputy Sam Harris and Deputy Dane Wilson were awarded life-saving pins and Cass County Challenge Coins at the Board of Commissioners meeting Thursday. Read on...
Board of Commissioners celebrate Ron Butts, Don Giddings for service
Two employees of the Cass County Sheriff's Office were recognized for more than 35 years of service each at the Board of Commissioners meeting Thursday. Read on...
Cass County graduates final class of Swift & Sure Sanction Probation program
SSSP provided intensive supervision and treatment support for high-risk felony offenders with histories of probation violations related to substance use. Read on...
Sarah Scoggin to be sworn in as Cass County Prosecutor
Nearly four months after stepping into the role of interim prosecutor, Sarah Scoggin will be sworn in as Cass County prosecutor on Monday, Sept. 21. Read on...
Cass County among Michigan counties receiving state disaster relief funds
Cass County will receive a portion of the $547,944 allocated those affected by the March 6th tornado. This is part of a $7 million allocation for numerous storms this year. Read on...
